body: 14 Nov 2026, DECISIONS by the advisor (owner away) for part B. (1) The design above is accepted, built STRICTLY IN SEQUENCE: A (scanner attaches to the owning ref) merges first; B-server is built on top of A and never lands before it (main publishes a server image on every server merge, so 'same release' = the order of merges); B-server needs a test that a scan after the repair creates nothing, and a test that re-describing a merged-away ref (joined artists, its old duration) lands on the survivor and creates no ref: refs.find must also consult ref_merge; take the next free migration number on main when the PR is cut (not 0010 by assumption); follow the one-contract rule: update openapi.json and save a REAL library/files response with the merges list as a server fixture; B-PHONE starts only after B-server merged and builds applyMerges against that saved fixture (a parser written before the server response exists is the drift the rule prevents). (2) THE 5 HELD PAIRS ARE NOT MERGED: they are two source items sitting together in 13 of the owner's playlists; merging would show one song twice there, a visible edit to his data he did not ask for. The defect is the keeper making two refs share one file (keeper.py:116, :193): fix scoped AFTER B-server (the keeper may reuse a file only for the same ref or a merged one, never for any ref at the same placement). Until then the startup repair logs the 5 on every start and that is expected, never a failure. (3) VM 108 is NOT updated to an image with B until B-phone has merged and an APK with applyMerges exists; then ONE engineering check on the emulator; the repair's backup path is logged in the homelab file before 'encore update'. The owner's A35 (build 144) keeps today's ghost rows: nothing gets worse for him. (4) Path facts for part A (real rows): the keeper's path is Encore/<artist>/Singles/<title>.opus, the scanner's is <artist>/[Unknown Album]/<title>.opus, so a plain path equality never matches (177 of 178 pairs); navidrome_song_id is the main key; the path fallback is only for the 2 keeper rows without an id and must use one normalised form or be dropped.
